_note: recency: 'current' = recent or ongoing relevance; 'historical' = no longer current but meaningful context (archived old-site news, 2016-2023).

news.title: Fire razes old public market in San Carlos City
news.summary: A structure fire razed the old public market in San Carlos City, Pangasinan. Vendors were relocated while the city assesses rebuilding plans (Philippine News Agency).

news.title: Resuello, Resuello re-elected in 2025 local elections
news.summary: Mayor Julier "Ayoy" Resuello and Vice Mayor Joseres "Bogs" Resuello were re-elected in the May 12, 2025 national and local elections along with 10 city councilors (Comelec media server via Rappler).

news.title: San Carlos City secures Seal of Good Local Governance
news.summary: The city government announced securing the Seal of Good Local Governance (SGLG), citing excellence in governance standards (official LGU announcement, archived).

news.title: CENPELCO announces mass disconnection drive
news.summary: The Central Pangasinan Electric Cooperative (CENPELCO) implemented a mass disconnection of delinquent accounts in San Carlos starting January 2024, citing the Magna Carta for Electricity Consumers (official LGU announcement, archived).

news.title: 2 more barangays declared drug-cleared
news.summary: The city announced two additional drug-cleared barangays as part of its anti-illegal drugs program (official LGU announcement, archived).

news.title: CDRRMO holds earthquake drill at BJMP compound
news.summary: The City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office conducted an earthquake drill at the BJMP compound as part of the city's preparedness program (old official site, archived).

news.title: BFP San Carlos leads tree planting
news.summary: The Bureau of Fire Protection San Carlos led a tree-planting activity with city personnel (old official site, archived).

news.title: City intensifies ASF disease control program ("Babay ASF")
news.summary: The city government intensified its African Swine Fever disease-control program, "Babay ASF", to protect local hog raisers (old official site, archived).

news.title: National Women's Month celebrations
news.summary: The city marked National Women's Month, including a City Environment Management Office engagement on plastic-use regulation (old official site, archived).

news.title: City joins volleyball, football, taekwondo, and triathlon festivals
news.summary: San Carlos athletes took part in volleyball and football festivals, taekwondo meets, and a local triathlon as part of the city's sports-development push (old official site, archived).

news.title: Mr. & Ms. San Carlos City 2018 pageant and sculpture unveiling
news.summary: The Mr. & Ms. San Carlos City 2018 pageant was held alongside the unveiling of a life-size sculpture (old official site, archived).

news.title: State of the City Address - first 100 days of Mayor Joseres Resuello
news.summary: Mayor Joseres S. Resuello delivered his first State of the City Address covering his first 100 days in office (old official site, archived).

news.title: Two barangays declared drug-cleared
news.summary: The city announced two barangays declared drug-cleared under its anti-illegal drugs program (LGU site, archived).
